notes.how_this_was_played: Every mayor in this transcript was played by its own separately spawned agent session, given only its own city's brief -- its persona, its engagement level and the notices its own check-ins put in front of it -- and never any other city's offers (spec #34, and #18/#21 for why the briefs are cut that narrowly). Exports and answers were written first, from those briefs. The winner picks were collected in a second pass, from the real blind ballots of the replayed game, by the same eight sessions with their personas intact -- a mayor cannot judge offers that do not exist yet. The clustering of each round's answers was made by a ninth, separate session playing the facilitator, because spec #25's aggregate is measured over a grouping the engine deliberately refuses to invent (see engine.aggregate).
